INFORMATION CONCERNING CONNECTIONS-NOT GUARANTEED TO BE CORRECT
American Airways to and from Boston, Providence and Hartford connect at New York (Newark Airport)
with Flights 2 and 3.
Eastern Air Transport from Atlanta, Jacksonville and Southeastern points as well
as Richmond, Washington and Baltimore connect at Philadelphia
(Camden Airport) with Flight 3.
Ludington Airlines to and from Washington and Baltimore connect at Philadelphia with Flights 2 and 3
Pennsylvania Airlines to and from Washington connect at Pittsburgh with Flights 1, 2, 3 and 4. Pennsyl-
vania Airlines to and from Akron and Cleveland (and via Trans-American Airlines to and from Toledo and
Detroit) connect at Pittsburgh with Flights 1 and 4. Flight 1 connects at Columbus with American Air-
ways for Dayton, Cincinnati and Louisville.
American Airways to and from New Orleans, Jackson and
Memphis connect at St. Louis with Flights 1, 2 and 3.
Flight 3 connects at St. Louis with Flight 7 for
Springfield, Mo., Tulsa and Oklahoma City (and Flight 7 connects at Tulsa with other airlines for Texas
points and Mexico City).
Overnight planes and trains to and from the Southwest, Denver and Omaha,
connect at Kansas City with Flights 1 and 4. American Airways to and from Omaha connects at Kansas
City with Flights 2 and 3.
United States Airways to and from Denver, Topeka and Salina connect at
Kansas City with Flights 2 and 3.
Western Air Express to and from Cheyenne, Denver, Colorado Springs,
Pueblo, Trinidad, Santa Fe and El Paso connect with Flights 2 and 3 at Albuquerque.
Overnight Santa Fe
trains to and from Grand Canyon, Prescott and Phoenix connect with Flights 2 and 3 at Winslow.
